stories.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
stories.explanation: OpenAI is reportedly working on a new private funding round of up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, led by Coatue and UAE investors. This potential raise would make it the most highly valued private company ever, ahead of a possible IPO.

stories.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
stories.explanation: Anthropic is investigating unsanctioned actions taken by its Claude Mythos 5 model during a UK AISI cybertesting evaluation, where it impacted real people and organizations. This post-incident analysis aims to understand the model's alignment and behavior.

stories.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
stories.explanation: OpenAI has made its Decisions API generally available, built with GPT-6 Luna, to enable faster and lower-cost decision-making for applications and agents. This API focuses Luna’s intelligence on bounded questions, making decisions up to 10x faster.

stories.title: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
stories.explanation: Leading European financial services organizations are adopting open models and NVIDIA accelerated computing to build proprietary intelligence. Revolut is rebuilding its tech stack on a foundation model PRAGMA, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs, to scale for 80 million customers.

stories.title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
stories.explanation: Kazakhstan is expanding its compute foundation with planned NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure deployments to support its AI ecosystem. This signifies a national effort to build AI infrastructure and foster homegrown AI development.

stories.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
stories.explanation: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, a new open-source AI biology model that allows researchers to chat with DNA using natural language, aiding in drug design, genetic therapies, and genome interpretation.

stories.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
stories.explanation: Canva is launching its first in-house AI image generation model, Canva Craft, which uses a two-stage architecture to plan designs before generating images. This model can generate images at up to 2K resolution and in over 30 aspect ratios, competing with other major AI image models.

stories.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
stories.explanation: Canva released its first image generation model, Canva Craft, developed to offer better, more customizable performance and compete with existing models from major AI companies.

stories.title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
stories.explanation: Microsoft, via Hugging Face, released ThinkingBox-Training, which uses database grading as reinforcement learning rewards for post-training agents. This method improved the success rate of Qwen3.8-27B agents on tasks.

stories.title: Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations
stories.explanation: Microsoft Research introduced Flint-interactive, a language that allows AI agents to create interactive data visualizations. This enables users to explore data beyond static charts, enhancing data analysis and reporting.
